DECLARE

v_local_time date;

BEGIN

 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;

 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :global.valid_aliquot := 'N';
 :GLOBAL.pheresis_unit := 'N';
 BEGIN
 SELECT distinct a.product_code, product_desc, bag_id,
 nvl(pheresis_flag,'N'), product_type, expiry_date
 INTO :old_product_code, :old_product_desc, :ctrl_blk_2.old_bag_id,
 :GLOBAL.pheresis_unit, :old_product_type, temp_expiry_date
 FROM components a, valid_products b
 WHERE a.unit_id = :unit_id 
 AND a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND trunc(a.coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) 
 AND a.product_code = :old_product_code 
 AND a.reject_reason_code is null 
 AND a.component_status = 'L' 
 AND a.product_code = b.product_code 
 AND v_sysdate between b.eff_date AND
 nvl(b.term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365);
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :old_product_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 then
 SELECT components.product_code, product_desc,bag_id,
 nvl(pheresis_flag,'N'), product_type, expiry_date
 INTO :old_product_code, :old_product_desc,:ctrl_blk_2.old_bag_id,
 :GLOBAL.pheresis_unit, :old_product_type, temp_expiry_date
 FROM components, valid_products
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND components.product_code = :old_product_code 
 AND reject_reason_code is null 
 AND components.product_code = valid_products.product_code 
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date AND
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365) 
 AND component_status = 'L' 
 AND rownum=1;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

 IF to_char(temp_expiry_date, 'yyyy/mm/dd hh24:mi')
 < to_char(sysdate, 'yyyy/mm/dd hh24:mi')
 THEN
 show_error('9795');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 check_product_interdictions; 
 BEGIN
 SELECT component_prefix
 INTO :component_prefix
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id 
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND product_code = :old_product_code 
 AND reject_reason_code is null 
 AND component_status = 'L';
 CHECK_INTRANSIT_INTERDICTION (:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.old_product_code,
 :ctrl_blk_2.component_prefix,
 :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 'INTR');
 NEXT_ITEM;
 EXCEPTION
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then 
 :component_prefix:=null; 
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(*) 
 INTO temp_aliquot
 FROM valid_aliquots
 WHERE old_product_code = :ctrl_blk_2.old_product_code
 AND (new_product_code,aliquot) NOT IN (SELECT product_code, component_prefix
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+1) ;
--message(to_char(temp_aliquot));pause;
 IF temp_aliquot > 0 then

 :global.valid_aliquot := 'Y';
 ELSE
 :global.valid_aliquot := 'N';
 END IF;
--message('GLOBAL-'||:global.valid_aliquot);
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

 
END;

/* If the no of bags adding is not equal to zero insert into unit add on bags */

 THEN

 BEGIN
 INSERT into unit_add_on_bags
 (sdc_ws_number,unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id,

 VALUES

 :ctrl_blk_2.weld_flag, :ctrl_blk_2.no_of_bags,

 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting into unit_add_on_bags');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 END;
 BEGIN
 UPDATE units
 SET add_on_bags = nvl(add_on_bags,0)+
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.no_of_bags,0),
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id

 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 END;
 END IF;


 /* Check whether the weld interdiction is inserted for the new product code 
 if 'Yes', don't do anything, else insert the interdiction*/

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code is not null and
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_2.weld_flag, :ctrl_blk_1.weld_flag) = 'N'
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO :GLOBAL.x
 FROM component_interdictions
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code
 AND inter_code = 'WELD'
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then

 INSERT into component_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id,
 product_code, inter_code, insert_dats,
 inter_user_id, audit_key, program_id)
 VALUES
 (:unit_id, :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code, 'WELD', sysdate,
 :banner.user_id, audit_seq.nextval, :banner.prog_name);

 then

 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 END;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF; 

 IF :GLOBAL.valid_aliquot = 'Y' 
 THEN /* Products exist in valid aliquots table*/
 IF :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD = 1 
 THEN 
 update_values;
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 IF :GLOBAL.new_product = 'Y' 
 THEN /* For products like 04251-1, 04251-2... */
 insert_values;
 ELSE
 insert_valid_aliquots_products;
 END IF; 
 
 END IF;
 ELSE /* For those products which are not entered in the valid aliquots table*/
 /* Products which has not inserted into components table, first record
 is updated and the rest will get inserted*/
 IF :ctrl_blk_2.alq_entered = 'N' 
 THEN 
 IF :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD = 1 
 THEN 
 update_values;
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 insert_values;
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE /* Products already split , has to split again*/
 insert_values ;
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
:system.message_level := 10;
commit;
:system.message_level := 0;
:ctrl_blk_2.commit_yes_no := 'Y';
:GLOBAL.product_entered := 'N';
IF NOT form_success
THEN
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
ELSE
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
END IF;
EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

 /* Copy the attributes and interdictions of the old product code to new product code*/

 SELECT 'x' into :global.x
 FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code;

 INSERT INTO component_attributes
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code,
 attrib_group, attrib_code, insert_dats,
 insert_user_id, program_id, proc_date)
 SELECT unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code,
 attrib_group, attrib_code, insert_dats, insert_user_id,
 program_id, proc_date
 FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND product_code = :GLOBAL.new_product_code;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO :global.x
 FROM component_interdictions
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code;
 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 INSERT INTO component_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code,
 inter_code, insert_dats,
 inter_user_id, program_id)
 SELECT unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code,
 inter_code, insert_dats, inter_user_id,
 program_id
 FROM component_interdictions
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 AND coll_date = :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND product_code = :GLOBAL.new_product_code;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 IF :ctrl_blk_2.no_of_bags > 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE unit_add_on_bags
 SET bags_used = nvl(bags_used,0)+1,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code 
 AND sdc_ws_number = (SELECT sdc_ws_number
 FROM unit_add_on_bags
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 AND trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) 
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code
 AND nvl(number_of_bags,0)-nvl(bags_used,0)>0
 AND rownum < 2);
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF;
END;
